name: Supervisor Fizsprocket
summary: In Mulgore, Morin Cloudstalker calls for help against the Venture Company mine. Documents from a ruined caravan show a plan to drive the tauren from their homeland, and Morin needs Supervisor Fizsprocket's clipboard.

sections.title: A Plot Against the Plains
sections.body: A Venture Company caravan lies destroyed, and its documents reveal a plan to drive the tauren from Mulgore. The company wants the plains and the veins beneath them for itself. It means to take their resources without the tauren in its way.

sections.title: Strike at the Foreman
sections.body: Morin Cloudstalker sends champions to the Venture Company mine east of the Ravaged Caravan. Supervisor Fizsprocket runs the mine deep in its right-hand tunnels, among the workers and sub-bosses. Morin seeks Fizsprocket's clipboard for what it may reveal about the company's next plans.

faq.answer: Supervisor Fizsprocket directs Venture Company operations in the mine in eastern Mulgore. He oversees the workers digging into the earth and carries out the company's plans in the region.

faq.q: Why does Morin Cloudstalker want Fizsprocket dead?
faq.answer: Documents from a raided caravan show that the Venture Company plans to drive the tauren from Mulgore for profit. Morin Cloudstalker wants Fizsprocket dead because he oversees those schemes.
Fizsprocket is inside the Venture Company mine east of the Ravaged Caravan in Mulgore. Follow the right-hand tunnel to a chamber with workers and supervisors.

faq.q: What proof does Morin require of Fizsprocket's defeat?
faq.answer: Morin Cloudstalker wants Fizsprocket's personal clipboard. Its records may reveal the Venture Company's further plans in Mulgore.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is in Mulgore to strip its timber, minerals, and underground wealth. It disregards the people who live there and the land it takes from.

faq.q: Does killing Fizsprocket drive the Venture Company away completely?
faq.answer: No. Fizsprocket's death disrupts local leadership and gives Morin Cloudstalker notes on the company's plans. The Venture Company remains a threat in Mulgore's hills.

angles.text: As a tauren, you defend your people and land when you strike at Fizsprocket. His company plans to drive your tribe from Mulgore and plunder its earth.
As a member of the Horde, you help the tauren resist the Venture Company's advance. You defend the Horde's heartlands in Kalimdor.
